checked: 2026-10-10, by hand, against the oracle text of every non-basic source and an independent count of the pips (a plain symbol tally of the 99 non-land cards and the commander: W 18, R 26, G 56).
notes: Pips: Gishath, Sun's Avatar is {5}{R}{G}{W}, so the commander adds one each of R, G and W. The deck has no U or B pip and no hybrid pip.

source cards 43 = 34 lands that add a colored mana (18 basics, 16 non-basic) + 9 non-land sources (Arcane Signet, Atzocan Seer, Farseek, Great Forest Druid, Gwenna, Herd Heirloom, Ranging Raptors, Topiary Stomper, Nature's Lore). colorlessSupply (6) is Sol Ring plus five lands that add {C}: Kessig Wolf Run and Sunhome (colorless only, so in no color's share) and Secluded Courtyard, Sheltering Landscape and Unclaimed Territory (a {C} ability beside a colored one, so also counted in the colors they add).

Targets: 43 x 18/100 = 7.74 -> 8 (W); 43 x 26/100 = 11.18 -> 11 (R); 43 x 56/100 = 24.08 -> 24 (G). Gap = target - sources: W 8-26 = -18, R 11-27 = -16, G 24-28 = -4. No color is short; green has the thinnest cover.

Policy the count follows (the Colors card's own, not Mana Balance's): an any-color source with a spending restriction (Herd Heirloom, Gwenna, Secluded Courtyard, Unclaimed Territory) counts for each deck color; a land that fetches a basic (Evolving Wilds, Fabled Passage, Escape Tunnel, Sheltering Landscape) counts for the basics it can fetch; Farseek names Plains, Island, Swamp and Mountain, so it counts for W, U, B and R and not G; Nature's Lore names Forest, so G only. U and B each read 1 source (Farseek) against 0 pips, which is why they show a gap of -1.

Cards that look like sources and are not: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion and Kessig Wolf Run add {C} only (their R/W cost sits in an activated ability, not an 'add' clause); Mosswort Bridge and Spinerock Knoll add one color (G, R) and their hideaway costs are not mana.
